sections.title: Sound of kn
paragraphs: The letters kn make one single sound. You hear this sound in (knee) /ni/, the joint in the middle of your leg. The group has only one sound in English. The first letter is completely silent. You only pronounce the second letter.

sections.title: How to say kn
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Keep your lips apart and relax your jaw. Send the air out through your nose. Turn your voice on so your vocal cords vibrate. Put your hand on your throat to feel the buzz.

sections.title: Spelling of kn
paragraphs: The letters kn appear at the beginning of a word before a vowel. You never pronounce the first letter. You say only the second letter, which sounds as in (knot) /nɒt/. The pattern always creates the exact same sound in every English word.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Learners often try to pronounce the first letter as a hard burst of air. Do not make any sound with the back of your tongue. Start immediately with the tongue on the tooth ridge, exactly as in net. If you hear a click, stop and try again.
